{{Quote|What can't they do?|A reference to the versatility and usefulness of the X2-C3|<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|x2-c3-imperial-astromech|X2-C3 Imperial astromech}}</ref>}}
'''X2-C3 Imperial astromechs''' was a line of highly versatile [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They employed an advanced [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] and had impressive analytical abilities. Because of their flexibility and efficiency&mdash;including on the battlefield, where they made use of standard droid blaster attachments as well as a variety of specialized armaments&mdash;they were found on practically every Imperial military installation and ship.

==Behind the scenes==
The X2-C3 Imperial astromech was first introduced in a [http://www.swtor.com/info/holonet holonet] article for the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game. It bears a striking resemblance to [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4-series agromech droids]].
